text.p: Leeds United sacked manager Howard Wilkinson on Monday two days after the club lost 4-0 at home to premier league champions Manchester United.
Wilkinson arrived at Leeds almost eight years ago from Sheffield Wednesday and took the club to the league title in 1992.
The Leeds manager came under fire from sections of the crowd during his side's thrashing by Manchester United on Saturday.
Wilkinson, 52, took Leeds to promotion from the second division in 1990 and guided them to the championship two years later.
However, he has been unable to repeat the success demanded by Leeds supporters and the club finished a disappointing 13th last season. They are currently ninth with seven points from a possible 15.
Monday's announcement was made at a hastily-called news conference. Kenny Dalglish and George Graham have been among those rumoured to be wanted as manager at Leeds.
